package.name: perception_detectors
package.description: The detection models of the perception system, without ROS: interchangeable open-vocabulary backends (OMDet-Turbo, Grounding DINO, YOLO, YOLO-World, SAM 3, colored blobs), the pipeline of a detection request (class and category, tracker ids with StrongSORT or ByteTrack), the marked image, and the perception server that runs the models on another computer
package.author: Rodrigo Pérez-Rodríguez
